judgments.reason: The bioRxiv preprint has the same title and authors as the dataset. It describes the iEEG-fMRI dataset of 51 iEEG and 30 fMRI participants watching a short audiovisual film, so it is the dataset preprint.
judgments.paper_title: Open multimodal iEEG-fMRI dataset from naturalistic stimulation with a short audiovisual film
